rationale: Flip plaza_occupant_only_bonus=True so Red's parasitic-locust harvesters forfeit the shared plaza bonus while roaming outside the plaza — Blue's rotation keeps ≥3 specialists in-plaza, so the cooperators capture the shared payout and Red's free-ride on Blue-generated bonuses dies. Pair with the round-1 raid-economy kill (no held value, no seed inventory, expensive raids) and lower wq_growth_per_apple so Red's orchard poaching doesn't suppress Blue regrowth; raise bonus_value to 1.5 to amplify the now-Blue-concentrated plaza channel.
